dos.title: Respect the Constitution of Užupis
dos.description: When visiting the bohemian Republic of Užupis in Vilnius, read its whimsical multilingual constitution on Paupio Street.

dos.title: Try cold beetroot soup (Šaltibarščiai)
dos.description: Sampling Lithuania's signature vibrant pink cold soup served with hot boiled potatoes is a national culinary pride.

dos.title: Recycle beverage containers via Taromat machines
dos.description: Lithuania has a 92%+ recycling rate; deposit cans and bottles at grocery Taromat machines to claim your refund.

donts.title: Don't bring Soviet or Nazi symbols
donts.description: Displaying Soviet or Nazi symbols, flags, or uniforms in public is strictly illegal under Lithuanian law.

donts.title: Don't consume alcohol in public spaces
donts.description: Drinking alcohol in parks, streets, or public benches is strictly prohibited and subject to municipal fines.

etiquette.tipping: Tipping 10% is customary in sit-down restaurants in Vilnius for good service.
